subject.title: fix(cron): cap trigger script tool access

question: How should the gateway handle pre-existing trigger-script cron jobs whose stored payload has no creator-derived `toolsAllow`?
rationale: Creator provenance was never persisted, so code cannot infer a safe least-privilege cap; preserving execution retains a privilege-escalation path, while failing closed can stop existing automation.

options.title: Fail closed pending operator review
options.body: Detect cap-less trigger-script jobs and block or disable them until an operator explicitly reviews and re-saves the job with a current tool policy.

options.title: Grandfather existing jobs
options.body: Merge the current behavior and explicitly accept that previously stored cap-less trigger jobs retain unrestricted trigger tools until edited.

recommendation.title: Fail closed pending operator review
recommendation.body: Detect cap-less trigger-script jobs and block or disable them until an operator explicitly reviews and re-saves the job with a current tool policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work spans the cron tool, gateway, and service management paths, and this decision crosses security enforcement with upgrade behavior.
